title: Reinforcement Learning to Accelerate Primal-Dual Hybrid Gradient for Linear Programming
summary: Primal-dual hybrid gradient (PDHG) methods solve large-scale linear programs (LPs) using GPU-friendly matrix-vector products and projections, but their practical performance depends on coordinating algorithm parameters, acceleration, and restarts. We introduce GALLOP, which uses reinforcement learning to jointly learn continuous algorithm parameters and discrete restart decisions without differentiating through the solver.
